usedFor: When a Docusign envelope is completed, OpenAI (ChatGPT) drafts a summary or welcome note.

bestTemplate.name: “New Envelope Completed” in Docusign, then “Ask AI” in OpenAI (ChatGPT)
bestTemplate.why: Once everyone has signed, “Ask AI” turns the event into a written draft from your prompt.

watchOut: “Ask AI” is only as good as the details you pass in, so treat client messages as drafts.
